name: Hangar
description: Hangar is a self-hosted web UI for Claude Code and Codex. Sessions run in tmux, so you can pick them up from any device, with readable transcripts, a plan-usage dashboard, and GitHub sign-in for cloning and pushing repos.

notes.text: On the first visit, enter the setup code from Hangar's log: journalctl -u hangar. Then create the owner account and sign in with Claude.
Agents run as root with Claude's bypass-permissions mode allowed, so they can change anything in the container. Keep it unprivileged and don't mount sensitive host paths.
